title: WC: India extend dominance over Pakistan with 5-3 thriller, seal next-round spot
content: In a thrilling Pool D showdown, India triumphed over Pakistan with a score of 5-3. With Harmanpreet Singh and Abhishek each netting two goals, India showcased their strength. Pakistan's Hannan Shahid and Sufyan Khan put up a valiant effort by scoring, yet India held their ground during the nail-biting final quarter, securing their advancement to the next stage of the World Cup.

title: Govt planning to bring E10 back? Clamour grows after top bureaucrat's remark
content: E20 is petrol containing 20% ethanol and 80% petrol. The government has promoted higher ethanol blending as a way to reduce crude oil imports, save foreign exchange and improve India's energy security. India also achieved its 20% blending target ahead of the original 2030 deadline. However, the nationwide shift has generated concerns among some vehicle owners, particularly those with older vehicles.

The event highlighted the impressive achievement of Taiwanese participants, who collectively earned twenty-four gold medals, demonstrating the practical benefits of emerging technologies in daily life.

title: 'Speechless' Garret Tan silences Lakshya Sen and Delhi crowd at BWF World C'ships

Overcoming crowd pressure, a head injury and Sen’s aggressive play, Tan triumphed 19-21, 21-19, 21-17, marking the biggest win of his career.

title: US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18
content: Beginning September 18, 2026, new rules from the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services will reshape the Green Card application landscape. Applicants will undergo a more rigorous public charge evaluation that now includes a broader range of public benefits. Additionally, previous cash assistance and long-term institutional stays will factor into decisions, significantly affecting family and employment-based immigration cases.

Captain Shubman Gill praised their performances, emphasising the importance of this win for India's aspirations in the World Test Championship.

title: US tech firm asks court to block CEO who fired 900 in 79-second call

Garg allegedly violated securities laws by making misleading statements to regain his position. The board unanimously removed Garg after significant company losses and stock decline. Garg seeks reinstatement, offering to work for one dollar annually.

An investigation is underway to determine the exact cause and potential safety regulation violations.

title: 4,000-year-old painted stone in Indonesia reveals art carried by ancient Austronesians

The artwork predates Neolithic pottery, revealing a significant cultural development. Portable symbols likely traveled with Austronesian voyagers across islands. This discovery reshapes our understanding of ancient maritime cultural exchanges.
